data.title: 妮姆芙 · 晨曦微风中的薯片软糖小憩
data.description: 清晨的薄风拂过阳台的浅蓝窗纱，妮姆芙侧卧在铺满柔软靠垫的地毯上。宽松的浅蓝棉质睡衫滑落一边肩头，小巧精致的锁骨与雪肌分外惹人怜爱。透明羽翼如披风般半掩在身后，她单手抱着最心爱的草莓零食袋，另一只手揉着微睡的眼睛，嘴角泛起初醒时的香甜微笑，像一只终于找到避风港的精灵鸟儿。
data.location: bright peaceful morning bedroom filled with sunshine
data.action: 侧卧在铺满柔软靠垫的地毯上，宽松的浅蓝棉质睡衫滑落一边肩头

data.promptProse: Lounging comfortably sideways across a plush bedroom rug piled with cushions on a sunny morning, Nymph wears only an oversized sheer pastel-blue cotton nightshirt slipping off one bare shoulder over her bare thighs. Hugging a soft pillow with a sleepy, happy smile, she glows in pure morning sunbeams.
data.animaCaption: Lounging sideways barefoot on a plush bedroom rug propped against soft cushions, she hugs a pillow with a sleepy blush and sweet smile as her oversized sheer pastel-blue nightshirt slips off one shoulder. Bright morning sunbeams light drifting dust motes around her.
data.nsfwProse: She wears only an oversized sheer pastel-blue cotton nightshirt slipping off one bare shoulder over bare thighs and bare feet.
